queries: distinct literal AA20+U sequence or sequence and full canonical mhc_key
annotations: Lossless persisted records; arrays and objects are JSON TSV cells. annotations.json contains the complete graph, peptide provenance occurrences and source/long-read events, hypotheses and observations.
